body.purpose: The live transcript — the largest type in the system; the words are the interface.

window-title.purpose: Settings header h1, wizard step h2, and settings section legends — the framed windows' largest chrome text.

settings-body.purpose: The settings/wizard base text: leads, option copy, running prose at a ~62ch measure.

title.purpose: The update prompt's headline and settings card titles — sentence case.

label.purpose: The overlay's one-word status; settings field labels at 13px/550; pill labels at 12-13px.

hint.purpose: Settings hints, descriptions, and muted text in Dim Text.

caption.purpose: Single-line overlay detail (paste preview, error, hint) and the update note; ellipsized.

mono-value.purpose: Accelerators, prompt/dictionary textareas, the tabular version numeral — machine notation only, never prose.

timer.purpose: Captured-audio time in tabular figures so digits never jitter.

history-meta.purpose: Timestamp rows under history entries, tabular-nums.

shadows.name: capture-bloom
shadows.purpose: The recording dot's coral bloom, so the capture dot reads lit, not printed. Its wizard-demo miniature is 0 0 5px rgba(251, 77, 92, 0.5). Never surface elevation.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Input focus ring — a 0-blur spread that is an outline-equivalent, not elevation; paired with the border brightening to white.

shadows.name: capture-ring
shadows.purpose: The hotkey field's mid-capture coral ring (The Capture Exception) — 0-blur, outline-equivalent, sanctioned.

motion.name: card-enter
motion.purpose: Overlay card fade/rise-in from translateY(8px) scale(0.98).

motion.name: card-height
motion.purpose: The overlay card eases its own height so the transcript slides into new space instead of popping.

motion.name: state-change
motion.value: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease
motion.purpose: The universal state transition: keys, pills, tabs, inputs, options. Switches use 0.16s; active presses 0.08s (scale 0.92 keys / 0.97 pills).

motion.name: progress-fill
motion.purpose: All progress and download fills ease width linearly, driven from JS (incumbent shipped mechanism).

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: Status-dot breathing (the wizard mini-dot matches 2s); goes still under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: scroll-glide
motion.purpose: Settings index clicks glide the page; becomes a jump under prefers-reduced-motion. Reduced motion also collapses all settings/wizard transitions to 0.01ms and forces infinite demo animations to one iteration.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Below this the settings index docks horizontally above the page and the wizard demo stacks vertically.

components.name: Ghost Key (pause)
components.description: Quiet circular glyph key; hover wash brightens it, active presses it.
components.html: <button class="ds-key-ghost" aria-label="Pause"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="14" height="14" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5.6 4.2 V11.8 M10.4 4.2 V11.8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-key-ghost { position: relative; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; padding: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: #a1a1aa; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease, transform 0.08s ease; } .ds-key-ghost::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -5px; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-key-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: #f4f4f5; } .ds-key-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.92); } .ds-key-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4f4f5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Done Key
components.description: The one filled key — white check, the single strongest thing on the bar; disables in place, never leaves its slot.
components.html: <button class="ds-key-done" aria-label="Done — transcribe and insert"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="15" height="15" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3.4 8.6 L6.7 11.8 L12.6 4.6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" fill="none"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-key-done { position: relative; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; padding: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #f4f4f5; color: #18181b; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease, transform 0.08s ease; } .ds-key-done::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -5px; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-key-done:hover { background: #ffffff; } .ds-key-done:active { transform: scale(0.92); } .ds-key-done:disabled { background: transparent; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28); pointer-events: none; } .ds-key-done:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4f4f5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Discard Key
components.description: A plain X, gray until you mean it — red text + red wash on hover names the destructive consequence at the moment of intent (the Destructive Hover Exception). Labeled Discard while cancelling still means nothing is typed; Dismiss from delivery onward.
components.html: <button class="ds-key-discard" aria-label="Discard dictation"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="14" height="14" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4.3 4.3 L11.7 11.7 M11.7 4.3 L4.3 11.7" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-key-discard { position: relative; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; padding: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: #a1a1aa; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease, transform 0.08s ease; } .ds-key-discard::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -5px; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-key-discard:hover { background: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.12); color: #f87171; } .ds-key-discard:active { transform: scale(0.92); } .ds-key-discard:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4f4f5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Settings Pill Buttons
components.description: The settings/wizard pill tiers: filled white primary (the Done-key grammar), wash-filled standard, hairline ghost, and danger (red only on hover).
components.css: .ds-pillrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #18181b; padding: 14px; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-btn { border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 14px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: #f4f4f5; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease, transform 0.08s ease; } .ds-btn:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4f4f5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #f4f4f5; color: #18181b; font-weight: 600; padding: 9px 20px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); color: #a1a1aa; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); color: #f4f4f5; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.12); border-color: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.4); color: #f87171; }

components.name: Solid Input
components.description: A solid #101013 well with a 3:1 gray boundary; focus brightens the border to white with a 0-blur ring. The capture variant is The Capture Exception's one coral moment.
components.css: .ds-inputs { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; background: #18181b; padding: 14px; border-radius: 12px; min-width: 240px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #101013; color: #f4f4f5; border: 1px solid #6b6b74; border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 11px; font-size: 13px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.12s ease, background 0.12s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a1a1aa; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #f4f4f5; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); } .ds-input-capturing { border-color: rgba(251, 77, 92, 0.55); background: rgba(251, 77, 92, 0.07); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(251, 77, 92, 0.16); font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

components.name: Sticky Index
components.description: The settings section index: quiet 8px-radius text entries; the one currently in view takes the wash — no markers, no dots.
components.css: .ds-index { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 168px; background: #18181b; padding: 15px 10px 18px 12px; border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); } .ds-index-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; background: none; border: none; border-radius: 8px; color: #a1a1aa; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.12s ease, background 0.12s ease; } .ds-index-tab:hover { color: #f4f4f5; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); } .ds-index-active { color: #f4f4f5; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); } .ds-index-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4f4f5; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: White-Wash Card
components.description: The settings group panel: faint white wash + hairline edge, 12px radius, quiet 13px title; fields inside separate by whitespace only.
components.html:
Dictation
Global hotkey
Press once to start dictating, again to stop and transcribe.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 18px; min-width: 260px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #f4f4f5; margin-bottom: 13px; } .ds-card-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 550; color: #f4f4f5; margin-bottom: 7px; } .ds-card-hint { font-size: 12px; color: #a1a1aa; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A pill track holding pill segments; the chosen one takes a white 0.14 wash and brightens — chosen is white.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; background: #101013; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px; gap: 3px; min-width: 240px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-seg-opt { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; color: #a1a1aa; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease; } .ds-seg-opt:hover { color: #f4f4f5; } .ds-seg-on { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); color: #f4f4f5; }

components.name: Toggle Switch Row
components.description: Label + description left, switch right; engaging it fills the track solid white and the knob goes ink — the filled-white 'this is on' grammar.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; cursor: pointer; background: #18181b; padding: 14px; border-radius: 12px; min-width: 300px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-toggle-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; } .ds-toggle-t { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #f4f4f5; } .ds-toggle-d { font-size: 12px; color: #a1a1aa; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 40px; height: 22px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 11px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease; } .ds-knob { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: #a1a1aa; transition: transform 0.16s ease, background 0.16s ease; } .ds-switch-on { background: #f4f4f5; border-color: #f4f4f5; } .ds-switch-on .ds-knob { transform: translateX(18px); background: #18181b; }

components.name: Status Dot + Word
components.description: The state said as an 8px dot and one word; recording shows the filled pulsing coral dot with its bloom — the Filled Dot Contract.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: #18181b; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-status-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #71717a; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-status-recording .ds-status-dot { background: #fb4d5c; box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(251, 77, 92, 0.45); animation: ds-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-status-text { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 550; color: #d4d4d8; white-space: nowrap; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.45; } }

components.name: Progress Track
components.description: Hairline tracks: 3px coral dictation fill on the overlay, 6px white download fills on settings/wizard (One Voice Rule); all ease width 0.15s linear.
components.css: .ds-progress-demo { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; background: #18181b; padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; min-width: 180px; } .ds-progress { height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 2px; background: #fb4d5c; transition: width 0.15s linear; } .ds-dlbar { height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); overflow: hidden; } .ds-dl-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 3px; background: #f4f4f5; transition: width 0.15s linear; }

components.name: Update Panel
components.description: The quiet in-card note the app uses to talk about itself — entirely neutral-white grammar, no coral; the same grammar as the settings banner.
components.html:
Earheart 0.23.0 is available
You're on 0.22.0. It takes a few seconds.
components.css: .ds-update { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); background: #1f1f23; max-width: 320px; } .ds-update-title { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #f4f4f5; } .ds-update-note { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; color: #a1a1aa; } .ds-update-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-update-primary { height: 26px; padding: 0 11px; border: none; border-radius: 13px; background: #f4f4f5; color: #18181b; font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease; } .ds-update-primary:hover { background: #ffffff; } .ds-update-quiet { height: 26px; padding: 0 11px; border: none; border-radius: 13px; background: transparent; color: #a1a1aa; font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease; } .ds-update-quiet:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: #f4f4f5; }

narrative.overview:
Earheart is a clean minimal dictation bar played straight — the category canon of Wispr Flow and superwhisper, held to craft-bar standard. The live words ARE the interface: a solid near-black strip pinned low on the screen, hairline-edged, with the transcript growing upward above a single control row. Every control is a glyph the whole world already reads (pause, check, X); nothing on the bar needs a manual, a legend, or a label.

One color speaks: a coral accent lifted from the app icon's waveform-heart, and it means exactly one thing — "Earheart is working with your voice." The capture dot, the live waveform, and the dictation progress fill wear it; beyond the bar it appears only in two sanctioned capture moments (see The Capture Exception). Everything else is white and gray on near-black, with green and red confined to miniature status signals. The world explicitly refuses the hardware metaphor: no tape, no lamps, no legends, no eject. The previous "Tape Transport" service-panel system and the earlier violet/rose "On-Air Lamp" system are both fully retired; neither may resurface.

Scope note: the world now covers every surface. The overlay (renderer/overlay.*), the settings window (renderer/settings.*), and the setup wizard (renderer/wizard.*, which layers on settings.css) all speak this language; the framed windows extend the bar's grammar with white-wash cards, solid inputs, and pill buttons. The main process paints framed windows in Bar Ink before load (INK_COLOR in main/windows.js), which must stay in sync with --ink — the one name the value carries in both overlay.css and settings.css. The retired Tape Transport and On-Air Lamp systems survive only as historical notes.
keyCharacteristics: Solid neutral near-black surfaces; nothing translucent under text
One coral accent, reserved exclusively for the voice being heard or captured
Universally-read glyphs in circular ghost keys; one filled white Done key
Chosen things are white: washes, radio cores, switch tracks, the Save pill
Hairline edges and subtle white washes instead of shadows
The live transcript is the hero; chrome stays quiet around it

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Coral is spent only on the dictation itself — the capture dot, the waveform, the dictation progress fill. When the app talks about itself (the update prompt, model downloads), it uses the neutral white grammar: filled white primary pill, white download-bar fill. Never spend coral on non-voice surfaces.

rules.name: The Capture Exception
rules.body: On the settings window coral appears exactly once: a hotkey field mid-capture (.capturing — coral border rgba(251, 77, 92, 0.55), coral wash rgba(251, 77, 92, 0.07), 0-blur coral ring rgba(251, 77, 92, 0.16)), because the field is literally capturing the user's key press. The wizard's mini-bar demo is the only other sanctioned non-overlay coral: it is a depiction of the real bar, not a new use. No third use exists.

rules.name: The Tiny Dot Rule
rules.body: Green and red stay miniature: 8px status dots on the overlay, single lines of 13px status text on settings/wizard (.status.ok / .status.err) — never fills, washes, or large surfaces. One deliberate carve-out: the Destructive Hover Exception. Destructive controls (the overlay's discard key, button.danger pills) are gray at rest and take Failed Red text plus a red wash (rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.12), pills add a rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.4) border) on hover only — red names the consequence at the moment of intent, never at rest.

rules.name: The Pending Text Rule
rules.body: Streaming, not-yet-settled words render in Dim Text and brighten to Primary Text when cleanup settles them — the universal "pending" signal, done with color alone, no italics or spinners.

rules.name: The Machine Values Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for machine notation only: accelerators, timestamps, the version numeral, dictionary and prompt textareas, code and kbd. Prose is never mono — the hotkey fields' prose placeholders ("Click, then press…") explicitly render in the body face even though the field itself is mono.

rules.name: The No Surface Shadow Rule
rules.body: No blurred or offset box-shadow on any surface, card, key, or pill — ever. Two device classes are explicitly not elevation and are sanctioned: (1) the recording dot's coral bloom (box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(251, 77, 92, 0.45); its wizard-demo miniature uses 0 0 5px rgba(251, 77, 92, 0.5)) — a light-emission cue on a tiny dot; and (2) 0-blur box-shadow spreads used as rings — the input focus ring (0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)) and the hotkey capture ring (0 0 0 3px rgba(251, 77, 92, 0.16)). Zero-blur spreads are outline-equivalents that hug the border; they cast nothing. True drop shadows remain banned everywhere.

rules.name: The Solid Ground Rule
rules.body: Text never sits on translucency over the desktop. The bar is solid Bar Ink; framed windows are painted Bar Ink before load; in-window washes are safe because the solid ink is beneath them.

rules.name: The Keys Keep Their Slots Rule
rules.body: Keys disable and fade but never leave the row; the row never reflows and no key ever jumps under the cursor.

rules.name: The Filled Dot Contract
rules.body: The filled pulsing coral dot + moving waveform + running timer together mean "audio is captured right now." Mic warm-up is a pulsing hollow coral ring; paused is a steady hollow coral ring. Never show the filled dot before samples actually flow. Under prefers-reduced-motion the warming ring dims to 55% opacity instead of pulsing — dimmer = not capturing yet, full = paused.

dos: Do keep every surface under text solid; every window is opaque Bar Ink (#18181b) — the overlay by its own paint, framed windows via INK_COLOR in main/windows.js, kept in sync with --ink.

Do reserve Coral Voice (#fb4d5c) for the dictation itself — capture dot, waveform, dictation progress — plus only the two Capture Exception moments (a hotkey field mid-capture; the wizard's mini-bar demo). Keep WAVE_COLOR in overlay.js in sync with --accent.
Do use the filled-white grammar (Done key, Save / Get started pill, switch-on track, radio core, download fill) for the single strongest action, the chosen state, or the app talking about itself.
Do keep keys in their slots across all states — disable and fade, never remove or reflow.

Do honor the Filled Dot Contract: filled pulsing coral dot only while samples flow; pulsing hollow ring for warm-up (a 55%-dim ring when reduced motion stills the pulse); steady hollow ring for paused.
Do extend hit areas invisibly (::before halos to ~42px; radios and segments stretched over their whole row) instead of enlarging painted controls.
Do set machine values in mono (accelerators, timestamps, version, dictionary/prompt textareas) and keep prose — including the hotkey fields' placeholders — in the body face.
donts: Don't put blurred or offset drop shadows on any surface, key, or pill; the sanctioned exceptions are the recording dot's coral bloom (and its wizard-demo miniature) and 0-blur focus/capture rings, which are outline-equivalents, not elevation.

Don't use green or red beyond miniature status signals (8px overlay dots, one-line settings status text) — except the Destructive Hover Exception on the discard key and button.danger pills, red on hover only.

Don't reintroduce the hardware metaphor: no tape reels, lamps, legends, labels-under-keys, or eject glyphs; the retired Tape Transport and On-Air Lamp systems are historical notes only and may not resurface on any surface.
Don't spend coral outside the voice and the two Capture Exception moments; a third non-overlay coral use is a defect, not a precedent.
Don't make chrome text larger than the transcript (15px) on the bar, or larger than the 16px window title on framed windows; the words stay the biggest thing in the system.
Don't hide sections behind tabs on the settings page; the page is one scrolling column and the index is a map, not a shuffle.
